caption: This drawing depicts a single transparent drinking glass with a goblet shape, centrally positioned on the page. The glass has a cylindrical bowl with a smooth, slightly flared rim at the top, transitioning downward into a concave base that leads to a stem. The stem is sculpted with a bulging, rounded shape at its midpoint, tapering toward both the bowl above and the foot below. The foot is wide, circular, and flat, providing stability for the glass. The glass itself is rendered in shades of light blue and green, giving a sense of transparency and reflective qualities characteristic of glass. The entire image is enclosed within a thin rectangular border drawn in blue, and the background consists of an off-white color with a subtle gradient, particularly darker toward the edges. No additional objects or details are present within the composition.
title: Glass
